name: Volcanic Dragon: Obsidian Predator
description: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

abilities.name: Obsidian Scales
abilities.description: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

abilities.name: Avalanche Tail
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 4d6+4 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range and Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.

abilities.name: Dive-Bomb
abilities.description: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 2d10+6 physical damage and must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

abilities.name: Erupting Rage (Phase Change)
abilities.description: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them.
